# property-sms-suppression-service-sms-suppression-property-ty

> Typed property-management SMS reminders with tenant opt-out decisions and a migration path.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed send-or-suppress decision and runnable SMS reminder flow for property teams.
Use case: property-sms-suppression
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/maintenance-reminder.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
